A steel UB beam created one at a time keeps its profile name; the SAME beam created in a batch (AI structural placement, CreateBeamsOnAllLevels) arrives with `steelProfileName: undefined` — and BeamData.sectionType (:56) branches 'rectangular' | 'UB' | 'UC' on it. So a batch-created steel beam is drawn as a RECTANGLE. Column is the counter-example: all three of ITS emit sites carry an identical key set.
